'''Kote Medrit''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Mandalorian shock trooper]] who was present on [[Ruhnuk]] during the [[Third Galactic War]].<ref name="Ruhnuk" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Kote Medrit appears in the [[May]] [[2024]] Game Update 7.5 of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'', on Ruhnuk. Medrit is not a vendor and not part of any missions and therefore can't be interacted with.<ref name="Ruhnuk" />

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'' {{1st}}
